promises.label: Reach 20% through-cycle margins
promises.outcomeSummary: At the December 8, 2025 Investor Day, Deere reaffirmed its 20% through-cycle OROS goal by 2030 and said post-tariff work remained; achievement was not reported by November 5, 2026.

missing.what_was_said: Management explicitly cautioned that Deere was “not quite there yet”: annual guidance implying 20% margins did not mean the structural through-cycle goal had been achieved. The goal also included reducing margin variability.

promises.label: Reach 10% recurring revenue
promises.commitment: Generate 10% of revenue from recurring sources by 2030.
promises.outcomeSummary: Deere retained the 10% recurring-revenue ambition but moved its timing beyond 2030; it remained a long-term goal, with no completion reported by 2026-11-05.

missing.what_was_said: Management reported running autonomous paid acres that fall and said 2023 would bring another limited commercial rollout of autonomy—concrete early commercialization progress.

Deere reported selling more than 12,500 JDLink Boost kits since the second half of 2024, expanding its connectivity and SaaS offerings. Management said these developments supported recurring high-value revenues across the agricultural cycle, but did not announce attainment of the 10% target.

promises.label: Total autonomy for U.S. corn and soy
promises.commitment: Develop a total autonomy and automation solution for U.S. corn and soy; the initiating statement gave no deadline.
promises.outcomeSummary: The full-system promise remains pending. Deere progressed to autonomous-tillage orders; the 2030 target was stated earlier, though the initiating earnings-call sentence gave no deadline.

citations.title: Deere & Company (DE) Q4 2022 Earnings Call Transcript & Audio

missing.what_was_said: In discussing future SaaS offerings, management explicitly reiterated the goal of a fully autonomous corn production system by the end of 2030.
Management said Deere had covered over 200,000 acres autonomously since the start of its autonomous-tillage journey, adding evidence of operational progress beyond the order-taking announcement.

promises.label: Invest $20 billion in U.S. manufacturing
promises.commitment: Invest $20 billion in the United States over the next decade in product development, technology and advanced manufacturing.
promises.outcomeSummary: The $20 billion pledge remains open; Deere reaffirmed the next 10 years target and reported starting Kernersville excavator production following a $70 million expansion.

missing.what_was_said: Management reported recently starting production of Deere-designed excavators in Kernersville, North Carolina, following a $70 million expansion investment. This demonstrates implementation progress, not completion of the full $20 billion commitment.

promises.label: Resume normal capital allocation
promises.commitment: Resume normal capital-allocation activities in 2026 after pausing Q4 2025 buybacks.
promises.outcomeSummary: Buybacks resumed in fiscal 2026; first-quarter dividends and repurchases totaled nearly $750 million. Second-quarter shareholder returns were $635 million.

missing.what_was_said: Management reported returning nearly $750 million in cash to shareholders during the quarter through dividends and share repurchases, providing earnings-call confirmation that buybacks had resumed.
